rules.check: Next decision cycle: verify army_supply >= 8, production >= 3, and worker count >= 30.
rules.correction: Prioritize building additional production structures (Barracks, Factory, Starport) up to at least 3 total, and queue units from existing structures to keep them active. Maintain worker production toward saturation (target 30+ workers by 5 minutes). Avoid expanding until army supply >= 15 and production is active.
rules.title: Production Tempo with Economy Focus
rules.when: Time >= 240 and (army_supply < 8 or production < 2) and bank > 800

rules.check: Next decision cycle: confirm anti-air unit count >= 4 or presence of Thors/Vikings.
rules.correction: Add anti-air units to your composition: produce Marines from Barracks, or add a Starport for Vikings. Ensure at least 4 anti-air units or 2 Thors/Vikings. Maintain ground army and continue economy/tech development.
rules.title: Enemy Composition Response
rules.when: Enemy Intelligence indicates air-heavy composition (e.g., Phoenixes, Oracles, Void Rays) and army lacks sufficient anti-air (e.g., Marines, Thors, Vikings)

rules.check: Next decision cycle: verify army_supply >= 15 and bank < 1000.
rules.correction: Immediately convert bank into army: queue units from all production structures, prioritize combat units over workers. If production is insufficient, build additional production structures. Do not expand or tech until army_supply >= 15 and production is active.
rules.title: Recovery from Low Army and High Bank
rules.when: army_supply < 15 and bank > 1500 and (predicted_advantage == OverwhelmingDisadvantage or threat_flags indicate imminent attack)
